BrochureContent.Content:
*** First viewing Saturday 20th June 2026 ***

Lynam Auctioneers are delighted to present this substantial semi-detached family home to the market, occupying an elevated site in the highly sought-after Balally area of Dundrum.

Enjoying a superb position within this mature and well-established residential neighbourhood, the property offers spacious and versatile accommodation ideally suited to modern family living. The elevated setting enhances both privacy and kerb appeal, while placing the home within easy reach of a wealth of local amenities.

The ground floor accommodation comprises a welcoming entrance hall, a formal sitting room to the front, a spacious living room leading through to the dining room, a kitchen, a separate family room, a shower room and a utility room. The layout provides excellent flexibility for growing families and offers generous reception space throughout.

Upstairs, there are three large bedrooms and a family bathroom. The well-proportioned accommodation provides a wonderful opportunity for purchasers to create a long-term family home in a prime South Dublin location.

Balally is one of Dundrum's most established and desirable residential areas, renowned for its excellent amenities and convenience. The property is within easy reach of Dundrum Town Centre, offering an extensive selection of shops, restaurants, cafés and leisure facilities. The LUAS is nearby, providing excellent access to the city centre, while the M50 and major road networks are also easily accessible.

The area is particularly popular with families due to its selection of highly regarded primary and secondary schools, together with numerous parks, sporting clubs and recreational facilities.

This is an excellent opportunity to acquire a spacious family home on an elevated site in one of South Dublin's most sought-after locations.

Viewing is highly recommended.

• Mature and established residential neighbourhood with a strong family appeal

• Within walking distance of the Balally LUAS and close to Dundrum Town Centre

• Excellent proximity to highly regarded schools, parks, sporting facilities and major road networks including the M50
